title: After a companion disapproves of an action (e.g. 'Lys disapproves' right after killing a gaunt wolf), talking to them immediately after offers only the same generic dialogue tree — no option to ask why, apologize, or explain yourself in that moment.
where: Wolf Scrape / 'talk to Lys' right after the gaunt wolf fight
